Class MathUtil

java.lang.Object
net.murat.util.MathUtil
public final class MathUtil extends Object
Mathematical helper functions for 3D graphics and ray tracing. All methods are thread-safe and deterministic. FULLY GC-FRIENDLY - uses MathContext scratch variables.
